symptom: The rebuilt backend container could not publish loopback port 3000 because it was already in use.
evidence: Read-only port inspection identified EonVPNRoutingService as the listener; no credential, payload or raw log was retained.

root_cause.summary: An external VPN routing service owned 127.0.0.1:3000.

actions: Queried the incident index and inspected Compose/container state.
Resolved the loopback listener owner without stopping or modifying the external service.
Reran Compose with a temporary BACKEND_PORT=3002 override.
Verified running and healthy services plus UI/API reachability and bounded login outcomes.
reusable_resolution: Use an available loopback BACKEND_PORT override when port 3000 is owned by an external host service; internal frontend-to-backend networking remains on service port 3000.
prevention: Check loopback port ownership before Compose startup and avoid terminating unrelated host services.
